full_description: Habit Tracker is a simple app that helps users track and maintain their daily habits. It allows users to set reminders and monitor their progress. With Habit Tracker, you can easily create and manage your habits, set reminders and notifications to stay on track, and view your progress over time. The app is designed to be easy to use and provides a clear overview of your habits, making it easier to stick to them. Features include: creating and editing habits, setting reminders and notifications, tracking progress, and viewing statistics. Download Habit Tracker today and start building positive habits that will improve your life.
